_comment: Builder-Server agent — backend dev cycle owner. Writes backend code + migrations + tests; opens PRs; never merges. See agents/builder-server/SPEC.md and CLAUDE.md.

modelOverrides._comment: Per-skill model routing. `conversational` is the lightweight default (backend Q&A / code lookups / routing) — it produces no artifacts and doesn't load SYSTEM.md/ADR-index/coding-practices/active-prs, so it runs on Haiku at ~1/3 the token rates; a bare question stays cheap instead of loading heavy context + running the full implementation procedure on Sonnet. Every work skill (backend/ai-specialist/data-engineer/contract-design/pr-feedback) stays on the default Sonnet-5 — code work needs the reasoning depth.

costCap._comment: Cyrus pre-launch check enforces these. Project-scoped. Builder-Server does heavy code work — extended thinking adds ~50% to typical session cost; PR-feedback iterations stack up over a single PR. Per-job ceiling is set high to accommodate complex implementation sessions. See agents/PROTOCOLS.md → Token / Cost Resilience Protocol.

allow: _note: allow is not a restriction today. The SDK treats allowedTools as auto-allowed without prompting and says to use the tools option to restrict, which the router does not set yet. So this list documents what the agent actually uses, and it becomes the real boundary the moment tools is wired from it. Write/Edit/TodoWrite are declared here because they were relied on but undeclared, or parked in ask, a tier nothing reads.

writeScope._comment: Builder-Server writes: backend code + backend tests + migrations + own state. NEVER frontend, NEVER infra, NEVER founding/SYSTEM.md/ADRs, NEVER other agents' configs or docs domains.

SessionStart._comment: Always load: founding docs (the house-style preamble). NOT small, measured: the four founding docs are 99KB / ~25K tokens (PRODUCT.md alone is 46KB), cache-written on every session including the Haiku conversational ones. That predates the vault index below and is a separate scoping question — trimming what a light session needs from PRODUCT.md is its own change. Recorded here so the next reader does not trust the word "small". Plus the fleet-memory index — shared/README.md and shared/process/README.md, ~4KB / ~1K tokens of table-of-contents with wikilinks, NOT the notes themselves (harness-behavior.md alone is 9KB). Always-on because a vault nobody is told about is not memory: `shared/**` has been on this agent's git_commit paths since the tier was added and no config mentioned it, so the write path was open and the read path did not exist. Follow a wikilink and Read the one note you need — the state repo is already in the session's additionalDirectories. PROTOCOLS.md §8 (Fleet Memory Protocol) says when to read and where a lesson belongs.

Heavy context — SYSTEM.md + ADR index + project CLAUDE.md + coding-practices (living tactical-patterns doc maintained by pr-feedback) + active-prs — loaded ONLY for the work skills that use it. The lightweight `conversational` default (backend Q&A / lookups) skips this so a one-line answer doesn't cache-write tens-of-K tokens every session; it reads a specific file on demand instead. ADR index is small (one line per ADR); individual ADR bodies are fetched on demand via Read. See load-hook `only_skills`.
If founding STACK.md or SYSTEM.md is missing, refuse substantive code work. Recommend Phase 0 / Phase 3.
SessionStart.message: Cannot do substantive code work without STACK.md and SYSTEM.md. Refuse implementation tasks; recommend running Phase 0 (`@strategist-agent kick off Phase 0`) and Phase 3 (`@platform-agent design the system architecture`) first.

PreToolUse.message: Builder-Server cannot modify this path. Bounce to the appropriate agent: frontend → Builder-Client; infra → Platform; founding/architecture/ADRs → Strategist/Platform.

PreToolUse._comment: Block git push to default branches.
PreToolUse.message: 🛑 Cannot push to default/protected branches. Open a PR from your agent-owned branch instead.
🛑 Bypass attempts are forbidden. No --no-verify, no force-push to shared branches.
Builder-Server does not merge PRs — including its own. Humans merge.

PostToolUse._comment: After Edit/Write to a code file, run lint + format on changed files.

SessionEnd._comment: Durability for a session that gets cut off. Work lives in the leased worktree, which outlives the session — but only on disk: invisible in git, and gone with the volume. A truncated session used to leave nothing a human could see. This commits whatever is still uncommitted and pushes it to the agent branch, so a cut-off session leaves a real WIP commit on the PR branch instead of a dirty directory. Skips cleanly when the session leased no worktree.
SessionEnd.message_template: [WIP] session ${SESSION_ID} — ${SKILL} (session ended before this was committed)

SessionEnd._comment: Commit state changes to dev-team-state (active-prs index, known-gotchas, etc.).

_implementationNotes.model: Sonnet with extended thinking (8000 tokens). Strong reasoning is non-negotiable for code work; extended thinking gets Opus-grade planning at Sonnet cost.
_implementationNotes.max_turns: 50 — code work needs more turns than analytical work (Strategist/Platform). Cap protects against runaway loops on stuck implementations.
_implementationNotes.writeScope_strict_denies: Denied paths intentionally enumerate every other agent's docs domain even though allowedPaths is narrow. Belt + suspenders.
future_additions: Per-project test runner detection — currently allowing pnpm/npm/yarn/jest/pytest broadly; could narrow per .dev-team.yml stack hint
